free_tier_limits.correction: Up to 20M events and 100M metrics data points per month; includes 2 triggers and no SLOs.

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published through RateLimit and RateLimit-Policy response headers. Create Query Result is limited to 10 requests per minute, or 1 request per minute with relational fields.

notes: The listed base URL is the documented US endpoint; EU accounts use https://api.eu1.honeycomb.io. X-Honeycomb-Team is correct for ingest and configuration keys, while management keys use an Authorization Bearer token. Official documentation did not establish a general CORS policy.
